hero.title: Redefining the Used Bike Experience
hero.description: Velocita Indigo is more than a marketplace. We are a digital curator for the modern rider, bringing editorial precision to the world of luxury motorcycles.

mainCard.title: Unwavering Authenticity
mainCard.description: Every machine in our inventory undergoes a 200-point forensic inspection by master technicians. We don't just sell bikes; we certify legacies. Our provenance checks ensure every history is as clear as our commitment.

accentCard.title: Global Network
accentCard.description: Connecting elite collectors across five continents with a seamless logistical pipeline.

smallCard.title: Expertise
smallCard.description: Decades of automotive passion distilled into a seamless digital interface.

curatorCard.title: The Curator's Standard
curatorCard.description: Our standards are set by enthusiasts, for enthusiasts. We reject 85% of applicants to maintain our hallmark of quality.

story.title: Crafting the narrative of speed.
paragraphs: Founded by a collective of industrial designers and endurance racers, Velocita was born from a singular frustration: the transactional nature of the automotive secondary market.
We believe every ride has a soul, and every transition should be an event. We spent three years building the infrastructure to treat used assets with the same reverence as a new release.
Today, Velocita Indigo stands as the pinnacle of that vision—a sanctuary for the discerning rider where quality is the only currency that matters.
